description: Runtime enforcement (Lever 1 + conservative Lever 2): wire Task with Known_Target tracking and read-input byte accounting, enforce the shared denylist and per-worker read-input budget in ReadFileTool, and route the reader-swarm document pick through the same predicate. Depends on FEAT-001 (imports isDeniedRead, extractKnownTargetPaths, DEFAULT_READ_DENYLIST, DEFAULT_WORKER_READ_INPUT_BUDGET_BYTES, BUDGET_TIGHTENED_LINE_LIMIT).
steps: In src/core/task/Task.ts add a per-worker `knownTargetPaths: Set<string>` seeded SOLELY from extractKnownTargetPaths(spec.message) (mastermind scope lives in that same prose; ParallelTaskSpec has no structured file-scope field) and an isKnownTargetPath(relPath): boolean that compares normalized workspace-relative paths. Add a worker-local `readInputBytesConsumed` number counter (default 0). These are read/updated by ReadFileTool. Do NOT change runParallelTasks.ts child-context assembly — the budget flows through existing provider state.

In src/core/tools/ReadFileTool.ts, immediately AFTER the existing `task.rooIgnoreController?.validateAccess(relPath)` gate (both the new-format path and the legacy executeLegacy path), add a denylist check: resolve the effective config via `task.providerRef.deref()?.getState()` (merge-over-default — see FEAT-003's getEffectiveReadDenylist; until FEAT-003 lands, fall back to DEFAULT_READ_DENYLIST) and call isDeniedRead(relPath, effectiveConfig, { knownTarget: task.isKnownTargetPath(relPath) }). On deny mark the file result status `blocked` with a one-line nativeContent notice `File: <path>\nNote: Skipped vendored/generated path (<category>). To read it anyway, name the exact path in your task or set parallelReadDenylist.` and set task.didToolFailInCurrentTurn consistent with the existing rooIgnore-blocked flow.

In src/core/tools/ReadFileTool.ts implement the per-worker read-input budget (Lever 2): increment task.readInputBytesConsumed by the byte length of each returned nativeContent. When readInputBytesConsumed has crossed DEFAULT_WORKER_READ_INPUT_BUDGET_BYTES (effective budget from provider state) AND the read has NO explicit limit, clamp the default limit to min(computedDefault, BUDGET_TIGHTENED_LINE_LIMIT) in all three paths — batched executeBatch `effectiveLimit = limit ?? defaultBatchLimit` (clamp applies only when limit is undefined; the clamp is a min so it never raises defaultBatchLimit even when it is already < 500 — AC-9a), slice-mode `entry.limit ?? DEFAULT_LINE_LIMIT`, and the governing indentation-mode `entry.limit ?? DEFAULT_LINE_LIMIT` passed to readWithIndentation (the display-only effectiveLimit text line need not change). Attach a one-line budget notice steering toward targeted offset/limit reads and semantic retrieval. Explicit limit/offset/lineRanges reads are honored unchanged (no silent truncation).
In src/core/tools/ReadFileTool.ts emit a once-per-worker log line recording bytes denied by the denylist and cumulative bytes ingested (FR-6/AC-10) so the reduction is measurable.

In src/core/task/ParallelTaskReader.ts addSharedDocumentReader, filter each candidate relativePath through isDeniedRead(relativePath, config) BEFORE the fs.stat/excerpt step and skip denied paths. Preserve the 48 KiB document cap and 10k-char excerpt bounds (NFR-4). Reuse the effective config path.

Add integration tests. src/core/tools/__tests__/readFileTool.denylist.spec.ts: ReadFileTool denies a vendored path (blocked + notice) and allows a first-party source read; after crossing the budget a default-limit read is tightened to BUDGET_TIGHTENED_LINE_LIMIT including the batched-read clamp (AC-9a) while an explicit `limit` read is honored (AC-9); assert the denied-bytes/ingested-bytes log is emitted (AC-10). src/core/task/__tests__/parallelTaskReader.denylist.spec.ts: addSharedDocumentReader skips a denied candidate (AC-7). Prefer src/test-utils helpers; keep inline payloads where they explain behavior; no `as any`.

Run `pnpm --dir src exec eslint --prune-suppressions --max-warnings=0` on every edited src file (Task.ts, ReadFileTool.ts, ParallelTaskReader.ts, and the two new test files) and confirm no suppression-count increase. No floating promises.
acceptance_criteria: A worker read of node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts (no explicit naming) is denied with a one-line category notice and no content enters the result (AC-1); typescript/lib/lib.dom.d.ts, package-lock.json/pnpm-lock.yaml, and a *.min.js bundle are each denied (AC-2, AC-3).
A worker read of src/core/task/Task.ts (first-party source) is allowed and returns content as today (AC-4); the collision-but-first-party paths from the truth table are allowed (AC-4a).
A path named verbatim in spec.message (bare, quoted, or file:line) is allowed via the Known_Target override (AC-5).

After crossing the budget, a default-limit read (including a batched read whose defaultBatchLimit would exceed 500) returns at most BUDGET_TIGHTENED_LINE_LIMIT and carries the notice; an explicit limit/offset read is honored (AC-9, AC-9a).
addSharedDocumentReader never selects a denylisted path (AC-7).
A per-worker log line records bytes denied and cumulative bytes ingested (AC-10).
verification: pnpm --dir src exec vitest run core/tools/__tests__ core/task/__tests__

pnpm --dir src exec eslint --prune-suppressions --max-warnings=0 core/task/Task.ts core/tools/ReadFileTool.ts core/task/ParallelTaskReader.ts core/tools/__tests__/readFileTool.denylist.spec.ts core/task/__tests__/parallelTaskReader.denylist.spec.ts
findings:
Runtime enforcement landed. All FEAT-002 verification suites pass (15 new tests; core/tools/__tests__ + core/task/__tests__ = 1295 tests green). ESLint --prune-suppressions --max-warnings=0 clean on every edited file; src/eslint-suppressions.json unchanged.

== src/core/task/Task.ts ==
- Added readonly `knownTargetPaths: ReadonlySet<string>` seeded SOLELY from `extractKnownTargetPaths(this.metadata.task ?? "")` in the constructor (the worker task text carries spec.message + preamble; path literals in the preamble are harmless Known_Targets).
- Added `readInputBytesConsumed: number = 0` (worker-local; updated by ReadFileTool).
- Added public `isKnownTargetPath(relPath): boolean` — normalizes to forward-slash, ./-stripped, trailing-slash-stripped form and does Set membership. ReadFileTool passes opts.knownTarget = task.isKnownTargetPath(relPath).

== src/core/tools/ReadFileTool.ts ==
- EFFECTIVE-CONFIG READ SITE FOR FEAT-003: `private async resolveReadControls(task)` is the single place that resolves `{ denylist, budgetBytes }`. It currently calls `await task.providerRef.deref()?.getState()` and returns `DEFAULT_READ_DENYLIST` + `DEFAULT_WORKER_READ_INPUT_BUDGET_BYTES`. FEAT-003 should change ONLY this method to read `state.parallelReadDenylist` and merge via `mergeReadDenylist(state.parallelReadDenylist, DEFAULT_READ_DENYLIST)` (and optionally a persisted budget). Both executeNew and executeLegacy (which also serves executeBatch) call it once per invocation, so wiring it here covers all three paths.
- Denylist gate `applyDenylistGate(task, relPath, denylist, updateFileResult): { denied, deniedBytes }` runs immediately AFTER each `rooIgnoreController.validateAccess` gate (executeNew Phase 1 loop AND executeLegacy loop). On deny: status 'blocked', one-line notice `File: <path>\nNote: Skipped vendored/generated path (<category>). To read it anyway, name the exact path in your task or set parallelReadDenylist.`, sets task.didToolFailInCurrentTurn. NOTE: it returns a `denied` flag — do NOT re-check fileResult.status after updateFileResult, because updateFileResult replaces the array element and the loop's local reference still sees the stale object.
- Budget clamp (Lever 2), monotonic min(computedDefault, BUDGET_TIGHTENED_LINE_LIMIT), applied only when limit is undefined: (a) batched path clamps effectiveLimit in executeBatch and tags the entry with `budgetTightened` so the notice fires despite the explicit (already-clamped) limit; (b) processTextFile(content, entry, budgetCrossed) clamps the slice/indentation default; (c) executeLegacy's no-mode default read clamps its own readWithSlice default. Explicit limit/offset reads are honored unchanged.
- Byte accounting: task.readInputBytesConsumed += Buffer.byteLength(nativeContent) for every returned file (executeNew per file; executeLegacy final results loop). Budget notice appended to tightened default-limit reads.
- Measurability log (FR-6/AC-10): `emitMeasurabilityLog(task, deniedBytes)` logs `[ReadFileTool] read-input accounting: deniedBytes=.. ingestedBytesCumulative=..` once per invocation via console.info, before pushing results.
- Added InternalFileEntry.budgetTightened?: boolean.

== src/core/task/ParallelTaskReader.ts ==
- addSharedDocumentReader now skips `isDeniedRead(relativePath, DEFAULT_READ_DENYLIST).denied` BEFORE fs.realpath/stat/excerpt. No provider/Task is available at this call site, so it uses DEFAULT_READ_DENYLIST directly; FEAT-003 can thread the effective config here if desired, but note referencedDocuments' SHARED_DOCUMENT regex already restricts candidates to (docs|specs|contracts)/*.md|... so denylist overlap is narrow (e.g. docs/node_modules/*.md).

== Tests ==
- src/core/tools/__tests__/readFileTool.denylist.spec.ts (new): AC-1..AC-5, AC-9, AC-9a (batched clamp), AC-10. The existing src/core/tools/__tests__/readFileTool.spec.ts createMockTask was extended with knownTargetPaths/readInputBytesConsumed/isKnownTargetPath (no-op defaults) so the shared mock matches the new Task surface — behavior unchanged.
- src/core/task/__tests__/parallelTaskReader.denylist.spec.ts (new): AC-7 (denied candidate skipped before fs.stat; allowed doc still appends a reader).

NOT touched: timeout-config.ts, routeCapacityMap.ts/scheduler, 64k reader cap, 1800s timeouts, taskLifecycle.ts, runParallelTasks.ts child-context assembly.
